We deliver specialized, business‑critical financial and administrative services that enable our clients to operate their corporate structures, finance vehicles and investment funds across multiple jurisdictions.



Discover the Role

We are seeking a CRM Business Analyst / CRM Functional Consultant who will play a key role in gathering business requirements and supporting implementations of Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365) . The ideal candidate is resourceful, detail‑oriented, self‑driven and committed to deeply understanding business needs and translating them into effective technical solutions.

Strong listening skills, collaboration, openness to feedback and a sense of ownership are essential to success in this role. If you are driven by challenge, enjoy going the extra mile and want to work with highly talented professionals, this is the opportunity for you.

If you are an experienced Microsoft D365 CRM Functional Consultant seeking dynamic projects and a collaborative team, we encourage you to apply.



Key Responsibilities

  • Gather and document business requirements in collaboration with stakeholders.
  • Implement Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM solutions tailored to business needs.
  • Configure and customize D365 CRM to meet functional requirements.
  • Work closely with technical teams to integrate CRM with other systems.
  • Participate in project planning, estimating and project management activities.
  • Deliver end‑user training and provide ongoing functional support.
  • Maintain up‑to‑date knowledge of new D365 CRM features and capabilities.
  • Mentor and guide junior consultants when needed.


Key Requirements

  • Experience in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM implementation and customization.
  • Experience with version 8.0 or later.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Experience developing custom workflows, entities and plugins using C# or .NET .
  • Strong understanding of D365 CRM’s data model, security model and configuration options.
  • Excellent analytical, problem‑solving and critical‑thinking skills.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently or in a team environment.



What’s in It for You?

Career Development

  • Opportunities for internal mobility and career progression.
  • Collaboration with global colleagues and exposure to international clients.
  • Continuous learning supported by the TMF Business Academy.

Making an Impact

  • Direct contribution to simplifying global business operations for our clients.
  • Opportunities to support local communities through our corporate social responsibility initiatives.

A Supportive Environment

  • A strong feedback culture that supports growth and engagement.
  • Flexibility to work from our offices or remotely, promoting work‑life balance.
  • An inclusive environment where people are empowered and encouraged to grow their careers.

At TMF Group, our people define who we are . We thrive on entrepreneurial spirit and value proactive professionals who bring passion, accountability and excellence to everything they do.

title: Golang Data Engineer
description:
Golang Data Engineer #2613

Position Summary:


Our partner is a quantitative trading organization where live market data, low-latency systems, and proprietary models directly drive capital allocation decisions. As the platform continues to scale, the team is adding a senior engineer to own the real-time streaming ingestion systems that power live trading. You’ll build production-grade Go services that consume live WebSocket feeds, process and time-slice high-throughput market data, and deliver reliable inputs to a C-based trading engine running on AWS. The focus is demanding and meaningful: streaming reliability, automated failover, observability, and production debugging in a latency-sensitive environment where performance and correctness directly impact outcomes. If you enjoy building systems where milliseconds matter and your work influences real capital in motion, this is engineering at its sharpest.


Experience and Education:


  • BS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering or equivalent hands-on experience/field
  • Hands-on experience building production-grade distributed system for real-time or streaming environments
  • Strong production experience developing backend or systems services in Go
  • Experience implementing WebSocket-based live data ingestion
  • Experience deploying and operating services on AWS, specifically EC2 and S3
  • Experience building and deploying containerized services, ideally in Kubernetes environments
  • Experience supporting low-latency, high-availability systems where downtime or delay had direct business impact


Skills and Strengths:


  • Go
  • Real-time streaming systems
  • WebSockets
  • Low-latency architecture
  • Production service development
  • AWS EC2
  • AWS S3
  • Kubernetes
  • Containerization
  • Monitoring
  • Observability
  • Prometheus
  • High-throughput data processing
  • Failover design
  • Distributed systems
  • Debugging live production systems
  • Time-series data handling
  • Data pipeline development
  • Concurrency patterns
  • Systems reliability engineering



Primary Job Responsibilities:


  • Rebuild and own the production-grade, real-time market data ingestion system end-to-end
  • Develop high-performance Go services that consume live market data over WebSockets
  • Process and manage high-throughput streaming data across approximately 1,500 equities
  • Aggregate and time-slice streaming data for accurate downstream model consumption
  • Deliver structured, low-latency data feeds to a C-based trading engine running on AWS EC2
  • Design and implement automatic failover from live market feeds to delayed backup streams
  • Ensure data integrity and correctness during feed transitions and recovery scenarios
  • Maintain and validate the historical data ingestion pipeline sourcing from AWS S3
  • Instrument services with monitoring and observability to detect latency spikes, data gaps, and system degradation
  • Debug and resolve live production streaming failures with minimal business disruption
  • Optimize ingestion services for latency, throughput, and fault tolerance
  • Deploy and operate containerized services within cloud-native environments
  • Collaborate directly with technical leadership on architectural decisions and performance tradeoffs
  • Operate independently without daily direction, taking full ownership of reliability and delivery
  • Continuously improve system resilience to support live trading without manual intervention

title: Remote AI Quality Analyst (Portuguese) - 62131
description:
About Turing:


Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:


As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.


Key Qualifications:

  • Portuguese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Portuguese with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions.

Your day-to-day work will involve:

  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.
  • Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"overnarrating\".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.


Education & Experience:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and minimum 30 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 3 months



After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: DevOps Engineer SR
description:
DevOps Engineer SR


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


This is a highly sensitive and mission‑critical role with admin‑level access to the core platform. The ideal professional is exceptionally reliable, security‑minded, technically strong, and trustworthy, ensuring the stability, performance, and resilience of cloud infrastructure supporting large‑scale production systems.

You will lead cloud operations, infrastructure automation, observability, and performance optimization across AWS environments, ensuring secure, cost‑efficient, and scalable solutions.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Manage and optimize AWS infrastructure including ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;
  • Design, deploy, and maintain Infrastructure as Code using AWS CloudFormation;
  • Own and enhance CI/CD pipelines using CircleCI or similar tools, including automated deployments, rollback strategies, and environment versioning;
  • Implement and maintain observability frameworks leveraging tools such as New Relic and Splunk for monitoring, logging, alerting, and incident response;
  • Diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks across databases, services, network layers, and workloads;
  • Lead AWS cost‑optimization initiatives, ensuring performance and reliability remain uncompromised;
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional engineering, architecture, and operations teams to support deployments, troubleshoot issues, and evolve platform capabilities;
  • Ensure best‑in‑class security practices for sensitive production environments, including IAM hardening and compliance with internal controls.


Essential Skills


  • Expertise with ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;
  • Strong experience with CloudFormation for managing AWS infrastructure;
  • Hands-on experience with CircleCI or similar tools, including deployment automation and rollback strategies;
  • Proficiency with monitoring and logging tools like New Relic, and Splunk;
  • Ability to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks in database queries, configurations, and infrastructure;
  • Experience reducing AWS costs while maintaining or improving system reliability and performans.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Hands-on experience operating Amazon Aurora MySQL/Postgres in production environments, including version upgrade procedures, performance tuning, and troubleshooting;
  • Strong understanding of Aurora architecture, read replicas, automated backups, point-in-time recovery, failover mechanisms, and high availability patterns;
  • Proven track record performing database version upgrades in production with minimal downtime, including compatibility testing, replication management, and performance validation.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.
